e.body:
安盛（AXA）香港覆盖寿险、一般险（[[rim533]]）与健康险。

## 招聘方向
核保、理赔、精算、数据。 招聘信息见 [[linkedin]] 等求职渠道。
e.body_en: AXA Hong Kong covers life, general and health. Hiring: underwriting, claims, actuarial and data. Open positions are posted on channels such as [[linkedin]].
